Awesome Generator. I wasn't sure what to expect when I first downloaded this app, but after generating my Avatars I was incredibly impressed. First of all, they obviously came out as some of the best photos I've ever had - I had no idea how good looking I was (lol!). It definitely boosted my ego a bit.

What really surprised me was two of the pics had my hair parted differently from how I've always had it (due to the natural part), but these two pics had a style and part that was different and I really liked the way it looked. I went in to the stylist who normally cuts my hair and showed her the pictures and asked if she could cut and style it as in the picture. She was dubious at first, but when she was done we were both surprised at how well it looked!

Since then, I've used this app on other people's photos and each one has been thrilled with the results with a few even discovering something new to do with their hair, makeup, etc. The app gives great results and is fun to use. Beyond just the Avatars Generated at first, all the other styles and artistic settings have been great to work with. Overall, myself and my friends and family have greatly enjoyed the app and appreciate the work of the developers.

It’s A 5 star app but here is why I’m giving 3 stars.. The App is awesome in the fact that this is the top AI self portrait App. I’ve used other AI avatar apps & they come close but no cookie. But here is where I strongly believe other apps may capitalize on Dawn AI. When I first discovered Dawn AI not only was it mind blowing there were two things I loved about the app. The first thing was the search bar feature. With this feature u could literally type what u wanted the AI to generate and it would. For example, if u wanted to see yourself as a rapper u would type that into the search bar. Then Dawn AI would generate a limited number of avatars of you as a rapper. This put the creativity in the users hands on top of the many features & new looks you could already choose from. The second thing was once your avatar was generated it didn’t all look realistic. Dawn AI would generate multiple painted, cartoon & realistic versions of your avatar. I’ve heard Silicon Valley technologists argue about the vast rate at which tech giants are changing technology just to make unnecessary improvements. Sometimes if it ain’t broke don’t fix it. But maybe there was a legit reason for the change. Either way I think we should at least have the search bar feature. I’m sure many of you have tones of ideas on how u would like to see yourself as an Avatar that just isn’t in the app. After a while the same old ideas get boring. We can only see ourselves as a baseball player so many times before we’re like “ ok this is getting old.”
